With a system suspend, notice that the resume resets the devices and another enumeration.

```
[52533.772354] ehci_hcd 0000:001a:7: GetStatus port 1 001005 POWER
sig=se0 CONNECT
[52533.828063] usb 1-1: reset high speed USB device using ehci_hcd and address 2
[52533.832054] usb 6-1: finish reset-resume
[52533.832082] usb 5-2: finish reset-resume
[52533.884221] ehci_hcd 0000:001a:7: port 1 high speed
```

A complete log of the system suspend with host controller transactions is available on the CD-ROM. You can further explore the USB activities when system suspend and resume occur.
